tagline: The window between homes: a shared family screen for photos, calendar, messages and weather.

listing.detail: Turns a tablet or smart screen into a family window: clock, weather, photo frame, shared calendar, messages, shopping lists and chores, with a grandma-friendly design. Connect households to see each other's homes.
listing.audience: Families who want one shared screen at home, across generations and across households.
talkingPoints: Turns a tablet or smart screen into a shared family display.
Clock, weather, photo frame, shared calendar, messages and shopping lists in one app.
Built for every generation: large type and a simple layout for grandparents.
Connected households can see each other's local weather.
listing.callToAction: Open Family Frame and set up your family's screen.
avoidClaims: Family Frame is a hardware device. It is a web app (PWA) that runs on screens you already own.
Family Frame is made or endorsed by Google, Clerk or Replit.
Family Frame has a paid tier or subscription.
